# Aim
This analysis tests whether MOFA2 latent factors from the first union multi-omics model are associated with available clinical/pathology annotations.

The tested annotations include:

- TILs
- tumor cellularity
- pleomorphic invasive component cellularity
- age at diagnosis
- grade
- ER status
- PR status
- HER2 status
- HR status
- HR/HER2 subtype

Because the sample size is modest, this analysis is exploratory. Interpretation should prioritize effect size, direction, biological plausibility, and FDR-adjusted significance.
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
})
```

# Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
clean_sample <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- trimws(x)
  x <- gsub("\\s+", "", x)
  x <- gsub("\\(.*\\)$", "", x)

  x <- gsub("(?i)_T$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)_N$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)-T$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)-N$", "", x, perl = TRUE)

  x <- gsub("(?i)NL$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)(?<=\\d)T$", "", x, perl = TRUE)
  x <- gsub("(?i)(?<=\\d)N$", "", x, perl = TRUE)

  x
}

safe_spearman <- function(dt, factor_col, annotation_col) {
  x <- dt[[factor_col]]
  y <- dt[[annotation_col]]

  ok <- is.finite(x) & is.finite(y)

  if (sum(ok) < 5 || length(unique(y[ok])) < 3) {
    return(data.table(
      Factor = factor_col,
      Annotation = annotation_col,
      Test = "Spearman",
      Estimate = NA_real_,
      P_value = NA_real_,
      N = sum(ok),
      Note = "Too few valid observations or too little variation"
    ))
  }

  test <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(x[ok], y[ok], method = "spearman"))

  data.table(
    Factor = factor_col,
    Annotation = annotation_col,
    Test = "Spearman",
    Estimate = unname(test$estimate),
    P_value = test$p.value,
    N = sum(ok),
    Note = NA_character_
  )
}

safe_categorical_test <- function(dt, factor_col, annotation_col) {
  x <- dt[[factor_col]]
  g <- as.character(dt[[annotation_col]])

  ok <- is.finite(x) & !is.na(g) & g != ""

  x <- x[ok]
  g <- factor(g[ok])

  if (length(x) < 5 || nlevels(g) < 2) {
    return(data.table(
      Factor = factor_col,
      Annotation = annotation_col,
      Test = NA_character_,
      P_value = NA_real_,
      N = length(x),
      N_groups = nlevels(g),
      Group_counts = NA_character_,
      Effect_summary = NA_character_,
      Note = "Too few valid observations or only one group"
    ))
  }

  group_counts <- table(g)

  if (nlevels(g) == 2) {
    test <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(x ~ g))
    test_name <- "Wilcoxon"

    med <- tapply(x, g, median, na.rm = TRUE)
    effect_summary <- paste(
      paste(names(med), round(med, 3), sep = "="),
      collapse = "; "
    )

  } else {
    test <- suppressWarnings(kruskal.test(x ~ g))
    test_name <- "Kruskal-Wallis"

    med <- tapply(x, g, median, na.rm = TRUE)
    effect_summary <- paste(
      paste(names(med), round(med, 3), sep = "="),
      collapse = "; "
    )
  }

  data.table(
    Factor = factor_col,
    Annotation = annotation_col,
    Test = test_name,
    P_value = test$p.value,
    N = length(x),
    N_groups = nlevels(g),
    Group_counts = paste(names(group_counts), group_counts, sep = "=", collapse = "; "),
    Effect_summary = effect_summary,
    Note = NA_character_
  )
}
```

# Load MOFA2 factors and clinical annotations

```{r load-data}
factor_dt <- fread(FACTOR_FILE, data.table = TRUE)
clinical_dt <- fread(CLINICAL_CLEAN_FILE, data.table = TRUE)

if ("sample" %in% colnames(factor_dt)) {
  setnames(factor_dt, "sample", "Sample")
}

factor_dt[, Sample := clean_sample(Sample)]
clinical_dt[, Sample := clean_sample(Sample)]

factor_cols <- grep("^Factor", colnames(factor_dt), value = TRUE)

cat("MOFA2 factor table dimensions:\n")
print(dim(factor_dt))

cat("Clinical annotation table dimensions:\n")
print(dim(clinical_dt))

cat("Factors detected:\n")
print(factor_cols)

cat("Clinical columns:\n")
print(colnames(clinical_dt))
```

# Merge factors and clinical annotations

```{r merge-data}
merged_dt <- merge(
  factor_dt,
  clinical_dt,
  by = "Sample",
  all.x = TRUE
)

fwrite(
  merged_dt,
  file.path(ASSOC_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_scores_with_clinical_annotations.csv")
)

cat("Merged table dimensions:\n")
print(dim(merged_dt))

cat("Samples with missing clinical annotation:\n")
print(merged_dt[is.na(TILs) & is.na(ER_status), Sample])

print(head(merged_dt))
```

# Annotation availability

```{r annotation-availability}
clinical_cols <- setdiff(colnames(clinical_dt), "Sample")

annotation_availability <- rbindlist(lapply(clinical_cols, function(cc) {
  x <- merged_dt[[cc]]

  data.table(
    Annotation = cc,
    N_available = sum(!is.na(x) & x != ""),
    N_missing = sum(is.na(x) | x == ""),
    Percent_available = round(100 * mean(!is.na(x) & x != ""), 2)
  )
}))

fwrite(
  annotation_availability,
  file.path(ASSOC_DIR, "Clinical_annotation_availability_in_MOFA2_samples.csv")
)

print(annotation_availability[order(-Percent_available)])
```

# Continuous associations

```{r continuous-associations}
continuous_annotations <- intersect(
  c(
    "Age_at_Diagnosis",
    "Tumor_cellularity",
    "Pleomorphic_invasive_component_cellularity",
    "TILs"
  ),
  colnames(merged_dt)
)

continuous_results <- rbindlist(lapply(continuous_annotations, function(ann) {
  rbindlist(lapply(factor_cols, function(fac) {
    safe_spearman(merged_dt, fac, ann)
  }))
}), fill = TRUE)

if (nrow(continuous_results) > 0) {
  continuous_results[, FDR_within_continuous := p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")]

  fwrite(
    continuous_results[order(P_value)],
    file.path(ASSOC_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_association_with_continuous_annotations.csv")
  )

  print(continuous_results[order(P_value)])
}
```

# Categorical associations

```{r categorical-associations}
categorical_annotations <- intersect(
  c(
    "Grade",
    "HER2_status",
    "ER_status",
    "PR_status",
    "HR_status",
    "HR_HER2_subtype"
  ),
  colnames(merged_dt)
)

categorical_results <- rbindlist(lapply(categorical_annotations, function(ann) {
  rbindlist(lapply(factor_cols, function(fac) {
    safe_categorical_test(merged_dt, fac, ann)
  }))
}), fill = TRUE)

if (nrow(categorical_results) > 0) {
  categorical_results[, FDR_within_categorical := p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")]

  fwrite(
    categorical_results[order(P_value)],
    file.path(ASSOC_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_association_with_categorical_annotations.csv")
  )

  print(categorical_results[order(P_value)])
}
```

# Combined association summary

```{r combined-summary}
continuous_summary <- NULL
categorical_summary <- NULL

if (exists("continuous_results") && nrow(continuous_results) > 0) {
  continuous_summary <- continuous_results[, .(
    Factor,
    Annotation,
    Test,
    Estimate,
    P_value,
    FDR = FDR_within_continuous,
    N,
    N_groups = NA_integer_,
    Group_counts = NA_character_,
    Effect_summary = NA_character_,
    Note
  )]
}

if (exists("categorical_results") && nrow(categorical_results) > 0) {
  categorical_summary <- categorical_results[, .(
    Factor,
    Annotation,
    Test,
    Estimate = NA_real_,
    P_value,
    FDR = FDR_within_categorical,
    N,
    N_groups,
    Group_counts,
    Effect_summary,
    Note
  )]
}

combined_summary <- rbindlist(
  list(continuous_summary, categorical_summary),
  fill = TRUE
)

combined_summary[, FDR_global := p.adjust(P_value, method = "BH")]

fwrite(
  combined_summary[order(P_value)],
  file.path(ASSOC_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_clinical_association_summary_all.csv")
)

print(combined_summary[order(P_value)])
```

# Prioritize factor-annotation hits

```{r prioritize-hits}
priority_hits <- combined_summary[
  !is.na(P_value)
][
  order(P_value)
]

priority_hits[, Priority := fifelse(
  FDR_global < 0.1,
  "FDR_global_lt_0.1",
  fifelse(
    P_value < 0.05,
    "Nominal_p_lt_0.05",
    fifelse(
      P_value < 0.1,
      "Trend_p_lt_0.1",
      "Not_prioritized"
    )
  )
)]

fwrite(
  priority_hits,
  file.path(ASSOC_DIR, "MOFA2_prioritized_clinical_association_hits.csv")
)

print(priority_hits[Priority != "Not_prioritized"])
```

# Top feature weights for prioritized factors

```{r top-weights-prioritized-factors}
if (file.exists(TOP_WEIGHT_FILE)) {
  top_weights <- fread(TOP_WEIGHT_FILE)

  prioritized_factors <- unique(priority_hits[Priority != "Not_prioritized", Factor])

  if (length(prioritized_factors) > 0) {
    top_weights_priority <- top_weights[factor %in% prioritized_factors]

    fwrite(
      top_weights_priority,
      file.path(ASSOC_DIR, "MOFA2_top25_weights_for_clinically_prioritized_factors.csv")
    )

    print(top_weights_priority)
  } else {
    message("No prioritized factors at nominal p < 0.1.")
  }
} else {
  message("Top weight file not found: ", TOP_WEIGHT_FILE)
}
```

# Plot continuous associations

```{r plot-continuous, fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
if (length(continuous_annotations) > 0) {
  for (ann in continuous_annotations) {
    for (fac in factor_cols) {

      tmp <- merged_dt[is.finite(get(ann)) & is.finite(get(fac))]

      if (nrow(tmp) < 5) next

      p <- ggplot(
        tmp,
        aes(
          x = .data[[ann]],
          y = .data[[fac]]
        )
      ) +
        geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.8) +
        geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
        theme_bw() +
        labs(
          title = paste0(fac, " vs ", ann),
          x = ann,
          y = paste0(fac, " score")
        )

      print(p)

      ggsave(
        filename = file.path(PLOT_DIR, paste0(fac, "_vs_", ann, ".pdf")),
        plot = p,
        width = 7,
        height = 5
      )
    }
  }
}
```

# Plot categorical associations

```{r plot-categorical, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
if (length(categorical_annotations) > 0) {
  for (ann in categorical_annotations) {
    for (fac in factor_cols) {

      tmp <- merged_dt[
        is.finite(get(fac)) &
          !is.na(get(ann)) &
          get(ann) != ""
      ]

      if (nrow(tmp) < 5) next
      if (length(unique(tmp[[ann]])) < 2) next

      p <- ggplot(
        tmp,
        aes(
          x = .data[[ann]],
          y = .data[[fac]]
        )
      ) +
        geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA) +
        geom_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0, alpha = 0.75, size = 2) +
        theme_bw() +
        theme(
          axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
        ) +
        labs(
          title = paste0(fac, " by ", ann),
          x = ann,
          y = paste0(fac, " score")
        )

      print(p)

      ggsave(
        filename = file.path(PLOT_DIR, paste0(fac, "_by_", ann, ".pdf")),
        plot = p,
        width = 8,
        height = 5
      )
    }
  }
}
```

# Heatmap-style summary of association p-values

```{r association-heatmap, fig.width=9, fig.height=6}
plot_dt <- combined_summary[
  !is.na(P_value)
]

if (nrow(plot_dt) > 0) {
  plot_dt[, neg_log10_p := -log10(P_value)]
  plot_dt[, Direction := fifelse(
    !is.na(Estimate) & Estimate > 0,
    "Positive",
    fifelse(!is.na(Estimate) & Estimate < 0, "Negative", "Categorical")
  )]

  p <- ggplot(
    plot_dt,
    aes(
      x = Annotation,
      y = Factor,
      fill = neg_log10_p
    )
  ) +
    geom_tile() +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "MOFA2 factor-clinical association strength",
      x = "Clinical/pathology annotation",
      y = "MOFA2 factor",
      fill = "-log10(P)"
    )

  print(p)

  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(PLOT_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_clinical_association_heatmap.pdf"),
    plot = p,
    width = 9,
    height = 6
  )
}
```
